# How Swipe helped Mridani Clothing scale to 5,000+ monthly: A customer testimonial


> Running a growing fashion business is one thing. Running the paperwork behind it is a whole different beast. For Mridani Clothing, a brand built on handcrafted, ready-to-wear ethnic collections, the products were never the problem. It was everything happening behind the scenes. Invoices,[GST filings](https://getswipe.in/blog/billing-software/gst-billing-software-in-bangalore) , staff payments, and inventory were all handled manually which threatened to slow things down. Founder Shruti says Swipe changed that equation entirely.


## From a small stitching unit to a global ethnic wear brand


Nearly a decade ago, Shruti and her husband started small. Customers would bring in their own fabric, and the team would stitch it into shape. What began with dresses eventually grew into ready-to-wear sarees paired with matching blouses.


Today,[Mridani Clothing](https://mridaniclothing.com/) ships more than 5,000 orders every month to customers across India, and increasingly, to the US. But as the orders piled up, the operations behind it all got messier by the month.


## Troubles that Mridani Clothing faced


More orders meant more admin work. And admin work, as it turns out, doesn't scale gracefully on its own. The team found themselves juggling with:


- Staff payment records
- Billing and invoicing
- GST documentation
- Product inventory
- Return invoices
- Artisan pricing
- Countless Excel sheets


As she told Swipe, "Managing everything became extremely hectic because return bills, Excel sheets, artisan pricing, inventory, and billing information were all maintained separately."


Instead of spending time on customers or growth, the team was stuck toggling between spreadsheets and half a dozen different tools.

## How Swipe Helped Mridani Clothing


Mridani Clothing had tried other platforms before. None of them quite fit. Then a family recommendation changed the trajectory.


"My cousin introduced us to Swipe, and after switching to it, everything became much easier."


That one switch pulled several scattered processes into a single, coherent system.


### Everything Under One Roof


With Swipe, the day-to-day suddenly got a lot less chaotic. The team could:


- Generate invoices from one place
- Track staff payments without the spreadsheet juggling
- Handle delivery-related billing directly
- Edit invoices instantly, whenever something needed a fix
- Create GST invoices without manual calculations
- Cut down their reliance on scattered Excel sheets


Instead of hopping between five different systems, it was all right there. That alone freed up hours that used to disappear into admin work.


## Built for a Business That Sells Online


Since Mridani Clothing operates as an online-first brand shipping thousands of orders monthly, integrations mattered just as much as invoicing did. Shruti points to[Swipe's API integrations](https://getswipe.in/apis) as a standout advantage. Simple to set up, without the technical headaches that usually come with connecting ecommerce systems. For a brand depending heavily on online sales, that translated into fewer manual steps and noticeably smoother day-to-day workflows.


## What Actually Sets Swipe Apart


For Shruti, it isn't really about the feature list. It's about how easy the whole thing is to use. That's really the point, isn't it? When software doesn't fight you at every turn, you spend less time figuring it out and more time actually running your business.


By bringing billing, invoicing, staff payments, inventory, and integrations into a single platform, Swipe gave Mridani Clothing room to grow without drowning in admin work.
